name: cGZMessageServer2::MessageSend
notes: Lane KU. Applies pending changes, then under the lock copies the counted targets registered for the message's type and then for type 0 into a vector (its growth copies and releases logged and compared), unlocks, delivers in order, drops the vector and replays changes made meanwhile. Mutants (no type-0 pass, constructing in place instead of assigning, reverse delivery, no apply): killed or argued in notes/feedback/KU.md.

name: cGZMessageServer2::MessagePost
notes: Lane KU. Urgent messages go to the queue's front, others to the back (the queue counts them). Mutant (urgent inverted): killed.

name: cGZMessageServer2::AddNotification
notes: Lane KU. While a send collects, a counted (add, target, type) change is queued; otherwise the target is appended to the type's list (a new list for a new type) unless present, then the pending list replayed. Mutants (always append, push front, no replay, temporaries): killed or argued in notes/feedback/KU.md.

name: cGZMessageServer2::RemoveNotification
notes: Lane KU. Queued while a send collects; otherwise the first copy of the target is erased from the type's list and an emptied list freed. Mutants (remove every copy, keep the empty list, queue as an add): killed.

name: cGZMessageServer2::ApplyPendingChanges
notes: Lane KU. Called only by MessageSend (ours): every pending change applied in order (an add appends a copy unless present, a remove drops every copy and frees an emptied list), then the pending list emptied. Covered by the re-entrant sends. Mutants (append when present, erase only the first, keep empty lists, keep the list): killed.

name: cGZMessageServer2::ProcessPendingChanges
notes: Lane KU. Mutants (the guard, removes replayed as adds, an extra detach): killed or argued in notes/feedback/KU.md.
